name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoFlow_eq_value
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance),
  DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g →
    Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoFlow g)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.value (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.network g)
        (List.toFinset.{0}
          (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.maxflow (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.network g))))

source.code:
theorem rhoFlow_eq_value :
    g.rhoFlow = g.network.value g.network.maxflow.toFinset := by
  show ((g.network.maxflow.filter (fun a => a.1 == g.netS)).length) = _
  unfold Network.value Network.outdeg
  have hnd := (g.network.maxflow_spec (g.network_ok hv)).1.nodup
  rw [← List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (hnd.filter _), List.toFinset_filter]
  congr 1
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, List.mem_toFinset, beq_iff_eq]
  rfl
